title: Сообщение от Елены в сети  (A Message from Elena Online)

segments.t: Furious that Max created a social media page under his name without permission, Chef Barinov storms over to yell at him. Before Max can delete the profile, however, a friendly message from Elena pops up on the laptop screen, instantly changing the Chef's mind.
Я всегда думал, что ты просто идиот.
Let's walk back through the scene line by line.
Я всегда думал, что ты просто идиот.
'I always thought that you were simply an idiot.' In Russian, the idea of 'I' flows naturally into 'idiot' without extra filler words.
'Wait, you are not just an idiot.' Nastya addresses the listener with the informal singular 'you' alongside 'idiot'. Elena answers right away.
'Why the hell did you decide to do that.' Elena brings out the contrast between 'what a' and 'devil' in a few short words.
'Chef, I just thought it would help.' Chef Viktor brings out the contrast between 'chef' and 'and' in a few short words.
'Good afternoon once again.' In Russian, the idea of 'else' flows naturally into 'day' without extra filler words. Elena answers right away.
'How is your mood today?' In Russian, the idea of 'how' flows naturally into 'mood' without extra filler words.
'Do you have many guests?' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'guests' before landing on 'much'.
'It is a message from Elena.' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'message' and finishing on 'Elena's'. Elena answers right away.
'Wait, what is that?' The meaning hinges on 'what' working together with 'this' in spoken Russian.
'Do not worry, Chef.' The grammar packs 'yes' and 'worry' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange.
'I will delete the whole thing right now.' Notice how Russian expresses 'I' and 'to delete' with crisp inflection rather than helper words. Elena answers right away.
'We have to reply something to her.' Elena anchors the line on 'at', while 'answer' completes the thought.
'Write it down like this.' In Russian, the idea of 'write' flows naturally into 'like this' without extra filler words. Let's hear the full exchange one more time at natural speed.
Я всегда думал, что ты просто идиот.
That wraps up this scene as chef Barinov starts to scold Max for creating a social media profile in his name, until a direct message from Elena pops up on the screen. See you next time!
